name: sonora-personal-music

scripts.app:mac: npm run build && npm run native:island && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 && npm run sign:mac
scripts.check: node --check electron/main.mjs && node --check electron/phone-server.mjs && node --check electron/lyrics.mjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs
scripts.test:fullscreen: node tests/native-fullscreen-policy.test.mjs && node tests/notch-compact-window-policy.test.mjs && node tests/notch-hover-stability.test.mjs && node tests/native-island-state.test.mjs
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run native:island && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 && npm run sign:mac
scripts.test:playlists: node tests/playlists-e2e.mjs && node tests/artist-search-e2e.mjs && node tests/playlist-drag-e2e.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:simulator: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

description: A private, full-length personal music player for macOS
author: Sonora
